## ETL4 - Data Engineering at Scale

Medallion pipeline over OpenSky ADS-B data. **48 monthly flightlist archives** from Zenodo + **state-vector snapshots** flow through four tiers to a Postgres-backed dashboard and a reconstructed-trajectory experiment matrix.

```
  SOURCES                INGEST                 BRONZE                 SILVER (Raw Vault 2.0)        GOLD (Marts)             POSTGRES          DASHBOARDS
  -------                ------                 ------                 ----------------------        ------------             --------          ----------
  Zenodo (batch)    ->   screpper.py       ->   flightlists/          hub_aircraft                  dim_aircraft        ->   dim_aircraft     Flight Paths
    v23.00, 50 files     SHA-256 idempotent     (48 parquet, 6.4 GB)  hub_airport                   dim_airport              fact_traj_enriched Pipeline Results
  OpenSky REST       -> live_producer     ->   Kafka adsb.raw   ->   hub_flight (92.9M, 3.4 GB)    fact_flight              pipeline_runs      Ingest Comparison
    OAuth2, 17 fields    + kafka consumer       raw_states/           link_flight_aircraft (94.7M)  fact_traj_enriched       eval_results       DE Pipeline (this)
  Daily snapshots    -> daily_batch       ->   (3 parquet, 161 MB)   link_flight_route             fact_experiment_result   ingest_runs
                                                                     sat_aircraft_identity                                  fact_exp_result
                                                                     sat_flight_summary
                                                                     sat_state_observation
```

**Engines & roles:** `pandas` (streaming per-month vault builder, scales to RAM-bounded shards) | `DuckDB 2.0` (out-of-core finalize-pass dedup with memory_limit + spill, replaces the pandas concat bomb) | `Apache Spark 3.5` (applyInPandas on the state-vector satellite) | `Postgres 16` (serving tier + run telemetry + watermarks) | `Kafka 3.6` (stream ingest buffer) | `Prometheus` (producer metrics) | `Great Expectations` (schema + range gates) | `pyarrow` (parquet + dataset filters).

**Guarantees:** SHA-256 idempotent ingest, bounded-memory dedup via streaming engine, resume-friendly vault via `_DONE` sentinels, row-count reconciliation gates between bronze and marts, incremental refresh contract (ym=YYYY-MM partition, ADR 2026-11-13) for future per-month refreshes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(rows) AS value FROM pipeline_volumes WHERE layer IN ('bronze','silver_vault','gold_marts');
SELECT SUM(bytes) AS value FROM pipeline_volumes WHERE layer IN ('bronze','silver_vault','gold_marts');
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM pipeline_volumes WHERE layer = 'postgres' AND rows > 0;
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MAX(COALESCE(finished_at, started_at))))/60.0 AS value FROM ingest_runs WHERE status = 'ok';

SELECT CASE layer WHEN 'bronze' THEN '1. bronze (raw)' WHEN 'silver_vault' THEN '2. silver (raw vault)' WHEN 'gold_marts' THEN '3. gold (marts)' WHEN 'postgres' THEN '4. postgres (serving)' END AS layer, SUM(rows) AS rows FROM pipeline_volumes GROUP BY layer ORDER BY layer;

SELECT CASE layer WHEN 'bronze' THEN '1. bronze (raw)' WHEN 'silver_vault' THEN '2. silver (raw vault)' WHEN 'gold_marts' THEN '3. gold (marts)' WHEN 'postgres' THEN '4. postgres (row store)' END AS layer, SUM(bytes) AS bytes FROM pipeline_volumes GROUP BY layer ORDER BY layer;
SELECT layer, table_name, rows, bytes, files, updated_at FROM pipeline_volumes ORDER BY layer, table_name;

SELECT source || ' (' || pattern || ')' AS metric, CASE WHEN SUM(wall_seconds) > 0 THEN SUM(rows_out)::double precision / SUM(wall_seconds) ELSE 0 END AS rows_per_sec FROM ingest_runs WHERE status = 'ok' GROUP BY source, pattern ORDER BY rows_per_sec DESC;
SELECT started_at, source, pattern, wall_seconds AS wall_s, rows_out, bytes_out, status FROM ingest_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Experiment matrix - RMSE by method (latest run per noise)

targets.rawSql: SELECT method || ' @ ' || CASE noise WHEN 'N0' THEN 'Clean' WHEN 'N1' THEN 'Light' WHEN 'N2' THEN 'Moderate' WHEN 'N3' THEN 'Heavy' ELSE noise END AS run, rmse_m FROM fact_experiment_result WHERE rmse_m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY noise, method;

panels.title: Experiment matrix - wall time by method (latest run per noise)

targets.rawSql: SELECT method || ' @ ' || CASE noise WHEN 'N0' THEN 'Clean' WHEN 'N1' THEN 'Light' WHEN 'N2' THEN 'Moderate' WHEN 'N3' THEN 'Heavy' ELSE noise END AS run, wall_secs FROM fact_experiment_result WHERE wall_secs IS NOT NULL ORDER BY noise, method;

panels.title: Transformations & guarantees (what a DE prof grades on)

options.content:
### Transformations by stage

| # | Stage | Input | Output | Engine | Key transformation | Scale posture |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `screpper.py` + Zenodo bulk | CSV.gz on Zenodo | parquet in `data/raw/opensky_flightlists/` | threaded HTTP + `hashlib` SHA-256 | multi-file parallel pull, SHA-256 idempotent skip | bytes-level resume via `.part`, 48 files in one call |
| 2 | `bronze_flightlists` | raw `.csv.gz` | `data/bronze/flightlists/*.parquet` | pandas typed load | 16-col typed schema; `icao24` kept as string, dates parsed, `typecode` NaN-safe | per-file streaming, idempotent (mtime gate) |
| 3 | `kafka_bronze_consumer` | Kafka `adsb.raw` | `data/bronze/raw_states/date=.../hour=.../` | confluent-kafka + pandas | at-least-once; partition path authoritative for hour (no in-file hour column) | commits offsets only after flush |
| 4 | `raw_vault._chunked_flightlist_vault` | 48 monthly bronze parquets | 7 vault tables (hubs, links, sats) | pandas (per-file) + DuckDB (final dedup) | spill-to-disk shards per file; DuckDB `QUALIFY row_number()` for out-of-core dedup; `_DONE` sentinel resume | memory bounded to `memory_limit=4GB`, shuffle to `_duckdb_tmp/` |
| 5 | `raw_vault_spark.build_sat_state_observation` | bronze state-vector | `sat_state_observation/part.parquet` | PySpark `applyInPandas` | per-icao24 group transform parallelised across workers | real Spark cluster (3 workers) |
| 6 | `vault.marts` | 7 vault tables | 5 marts (`dim_*`, `fact_*`) | pandas join + aggregate | type-safe joins on hash keys; vectorised cross-track distance | reads full vault; incremental via `ym=YYYY-MM` ADR (pending impl) |
| 7 | `vault.postgres_sink` | gold marts parquet | Postgres `dim_aircraft`, `fact_trajectory_enriched` | `COPY FROM STDIN` chunked | server-side CSV ingest at 200k rows/chunk; nulls as `\N` | currently full-refresh (`TRUNCATE`); `INSERT ON CONFLICT` design in ADR |
| 8 | `bench.run_matrix` | silver `cleaned_states` | 3 reconstruction methods x 4 noise profiles | pandas + numpy vectorised | 17x speedup from vectorised cross-track distance; 3x from Kalman numpy loop | two-pass medallion-aware caching across (method, noise) |
| 9 | `qa.validate` | vault + marts | Great Expectations suites | ge pandas backend | schema, range, uniqueness gates | exits non-zero on any failed expectation (gates `sink` in `run_e2e`) |
| 10 | `qa.reconcile` | parquet footers across layers | drop ratio per layer | pyarrow metadata only | O(files), not O(rows); tolerance-gated | catches silent row drops before the matrix runs |

### Guarantees

- **Idempotency**: Zenodo pull (SHA-256), bronze convert (mtime), vault streaming (per-file shard gate), vault finalize (_DONE sentinel).
- **Memory-bounded**: DuckDB streaming dedup (4 GB limit, spill to local tmp); pyarrow dataset reads; parquet footer counts for reconciliation (no dataframe load).
- **Determinism**: single seed = 42 in `bench/noise.py`; event-time ordering per `icao24`; hash-keyed natural key encoding.
- **Quality gates in `run_e2e`**: `qa` (Great Expectations) between marts and sink; `reconcile` (row-count across bronze/silver/gold) between sink and matrix. Either non-zero aborts.
- **Recoverability**: `_DONE` sentinels per vault table; per-file shard skip on restart; `.part` HTTP resume on Zenodo; rewind primitive design in ADR.

### Known full-refresh gaps (ADR 2026-11-13 is the path)

- Vault, marts, sink, matrix, eval_mart all do full rebuild per run. The committed ADR specifies `ym=YYYY-MM` partition contract + `pipeline_watermarks` registry + per-layer incremental mechanism + zero-reprocess migration. Implementation tracked as the next wave.
- Watermark / cross-month flight / global uniqueness drift explicitly risk-registered in the ADR.
